results.snippet: Feb 2, 2026 · Purpose and Scope This document explains how to load custom audio samples into Strudel from various sources. Strudel provides multiple mechanisms for importing samples beyond the built-in sample banks, including GitHub repositories, Freesound.org queries, custom URLs, local file uploads, and a Node.js development server.
